parsed.post: Round 4: Kept the capacity scaling improvement (ASPECT_RATIO 48 -> 64), reaching 1.005966. This suggests the model has more headroom with increased width. Next, I'll experiment with weight decay and a slightly lower learning rate to regularize this larger model.
parsed.description: Testing lower learning rate (0.04) and non-zero weight decay (0.1) on the expanded capacity model (DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64) to stabilize training and improve generalization.
